parts.text: Generate the hierarchical bounded-reduction runtime exactly as defined by config.evaluation_heuristic. Return the configured hierarchical_reduction_runtime_implementation JSON. The returned implementation MUST include the complete config artifact for ChatMachines/GeminiEvaluation/hierarchical-reduction/config.json and the complete new special JS artifact for ChatMachines/GeminiEvaluation/hierarchical-reduction/hierarchical-reduction-evaluator.js. In particular, make B an outer reduction-iteration state exposed to config: B == 0 selects the base/raw-evidence evaluator class; B > 0 selects the decision/reduction evaluator class. Keep this rule in config, not hard-coded in JavaScript. Do not execute an audit and do not modify the existing historical-audit runtime in the proposed artifacts.
